questions.q: What is a subnet mask used for?
o: Divide an IP address into host and network parts
questions.e: A subnet mask separates the network part of an address from the host part.

questions.q: What is subnetting?
o: Dividing a network into multiple smaller networks
Combining multiple networks into a larger network
questions.e: Subnetting splits one network into several smaller networks.

questions.e: 1000 hosts need 10 host bits, so the prefix is /22. From /16 that gives 2^6 = 64 subnets.
